changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapRuleMap') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleMap]( [MapRuleID] [int] NOT NULL, [MapID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapRuleMap] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [MapID] ASC, [MapRuleID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapRuleMap_Map') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleMap] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleMap_Map] FOREIGN KEY([MapID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Map] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleMap] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleMap_Map] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapRuleMap_MapRule') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleMap] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleMap_MapRule] FOREIGN KEY([MapRuleID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapRule] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleMap] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleMap_MapRule] END
